title: Dynamics 365 Customer Service: Customer Service skills in Copilot Cowork
summary: The briefing passes: the roadmap facts, licensing statements and documented controls are supported, and it reports the sources' differing descriptions of arrival rather than choosing one. Minor corrections would finish the spending-policy path at Cowork and remove the checklist instruction to check MCP configuration, which has no controls-table row.

claims.claim: The Customer Service plugin supplies skills for case workflows in Copilot Cowork.
claims.quote: Use the plugin for Dynamics 365 Customer Service in Microsoft Copilot Cowork to delegate end-to-end case workflows.

claims.claim: The roadmap describes the plugin as available out of the box for service representatives.
claims.quote: The plugin in Copilot Cowork is available out of the box for service representatives.

claims.claim: The roadmap says representatives use the skills after an administrator enables the plugin in Cowork settings.
claims.quote: They can use the Customer Service skills after the administrator enables the plugin for them in Cowork settings.

claims.quote: Prioritizes and enriches cases: Surfaces highest-attention cases with suggested next actions.

claims.claim: The roadmap lists likely root-cause and ranked resolution suggestions.
claims.quote: Summarizes root cause and resolution: Proposes likely cause and ranked next-step resolutions.
